name: Seller onboarding agent
oneLine: A LangGraph agent that checks a new seller's KYC, tax and legal documents, and retries a failed check instead of guessing. Activation went from days to minutes.
status: In production at my day job

case.title: A seller onboarding agent that *retries* instead of guessing.
